dedupe_keys.name: 澳門氣候資料 macao climate data service of the meteorological and geophysical bureau smg on request

description: The Meteorological and Geophysical Bureau (SMG) of the Macao Special Administrative Region provides the territory's official climate records on request, as public service PS-1871 on the government portal. The service page read on 2026-09-28 says SMG collects and reviews Macao climate data, including maximum, minimum and mean temperature, mean humidity, maximum and total rainfall, wind direction, wind speed and sunshine, that citizens may apply for these data, and that applications go to the bureau's Aviation Meteorology and Climate Division in Taipa. Coverage is Macao. Access is on request; fees, formats, delivery time and reuse conditions are not stated on the service summary read. Caveats: the portal summary does not list stations or record length, and typhoon signals and storm surge records are handled by other SMG services. It supports local hazard exposure and climate adaptation studies of Macao's dense urban infrastructure, such as rainfall extremes for drainage and wind for typhoon loading. Related record: data-dsec-macao-census-2021-housing-database-by-statistical-district gives the building and population data that complement the climate records.
